inputs.name: intake_text
inputs.description: Free-text compliance intake questionnaire describing the GPAI model provider, model characteristics, training compute, distribution mode, and existing compliance measures

outputs.name: compliance_report
outputs.description: Complete GPAI Code of Practice compliance assessment with gap assessment, legal memo, and executive summary

model_name.description: Name or identifier of the GPAI model

provider_name.description: Name of the entity placing the model on the EU market

training_compute_flops.description: Estimated training compute as a string (e.g. 2e26); null if not stated. Do not ask for it.

is_open_source.description: True if released under free open-source licence with weights publicly available; null if not stated. Do not ask.

open_source_licence.description: Licence name if open-source; null if not stated. Do not ask.

is_code_signatory.description: True if provider signed the GPAI Code of Practice; null if not stated. Do not ask.

distribution_modes.description: How the model is distributed (API, download, enterprise licence, etc.)

has_eu_market_presence.description: True if model is placed on EU market or put into service in EU; null if not stated. Do not ask.

is_fine_tuned_from_base.description: True if fine-tuned or significantly modified from a base GPAI model; null if not stated. Do not ask.

fine_tuning_compute_fraction.description: Fine-tuning compute as fraction of base model compute if stated (e.g. 0.30 means 30%); null if not stated. Do not ask.

has_systemic_risk_designation.description: True if Commission has designated systemic risk; null if not stated. Do not ask.

has_copyright_policy.description: True if provider has a published copyright policy; null if not stated. Do not ask.

has_training_data_summary.description: True if Art. 53(1)(d) training data summary is publicly published; null if not stated. Do not ask.

dach_presence.description: True if provider or deployers operate in Germany, Austria, or Switzerland; null if not stated. Do not ask.

is_gpai_provider.description: True if entity is a GPAI model provider under Art. 3(63)

provider_determination_rationale.description: Reasoning for the provider determination, citing relevant Art. 3(63) criteria

open_source_exemption_applies.description: True if Art. 53(2) open-source exemption applies (free licence AND publicly available params/arch/usage info)

exemption_rationale.description: Reasoning for exemption determination; empty string if not a provider

has_systemic_risk.description: True if model has systemic risk under Art. 51 (>10^25 FLOPs or Commission designation)

systemic_risk_rationale.description: Reasoning for systemic risk classification citing Art. 51 criteria

applicable_tier.description: One of: tier1_only (GPAI no systemic risk), tier1_and_tier2 (GPAI with systemic risk), not_applicable (not a GPAI provider)

is_dach_relevant.description: True if provider or operations touch Germany, Austria, or Switzerland

technical_documentation_status.description: Art. 53(1)(a) Model Documentation Form status: compliant, partial, non_compliant, or not_applicable

findings.description: Specific compliance findings with Art. citations

copyright_policy_status.description: Measure 1.1 copyright policy status: compliant, partial, non_compliant

not_applicable.description: True if model has no systemic risk; all status fields will be null

model_reports_status.description: Commitment 7: AI Office pre-market model report status

not_applicable.description: True if no DACH presence; remaining fields will be null

bnetza_authority_acknowledged.description: BNetzA as designated GPAI market surveillance authority in Germany acknowledged

bsi_cybersecurity_aligned.description: BSI cybersecurity guidance alignment addressed (systemic risk models)

works_council_considered.description: BetrVG 87(1) No. 6 works council implications considered

austrian_swiss_scope_checked.description: Austrian and Swiss territorial scope specifics addressed

measure_id.description: Specific measure or commitment ID (e.g. Measure_1.1, Commitment_3, Art_53_1a)

chapter.description: Chapter name: Transparency, Copyright, Safety_and_Security, or DACH

requirement_description.description: Plain-language description of the specific obligation

current_status.description: One of: compliant, partial, non_compliant, not_applicable

gap_description.description: Description of the compliance gap if status is partial or non_compliant; null if compliant

priority.description: One of: critical, high, medium, low — relative urgency of remediation

remediation_action.description: Specific action to close the gap; null if compliant or not_applicable

target_date.description: Recommended target date for remediation (e.g. 2026-08-02); null if not applicable

provider_entity.description: Name of the assessed provider entity

model_name.description: Name of the assessed GPAI model

is_gpai_provider.description: True if entity is a GPAI model provider under Art. 3(63)

exemption_level.description: One of: none (all obligations), open_source_partial (Art. 53(2) partial exemption applies), not_applicable (not a GPAI provider)

has_systemic_risk.description: True if model has systemic risk under Art. 51

transparency_findings.description: Findings for Tier 1 transparency chapter (always present if GPAI provider)

copyright_findings.description: Findings for Tier 1 copyright chapter (always present if GPAI provider)

safety_security_findings.description: Findings for Tier 2 safety & security chapter; null if no systemic risk

dach_findings.description: Findings for DACH-specific overlay; null if no DACH presence

applicable_obligations.description: List of applicable obligation categories (e.g. Art_53_transparency, Art_53_copyright, Art_55_safety)

compliance_status_summary.description: Professional narrative summary of overall compliance status citing specific articles

key_assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions made where intake information was incomplete

recommendations.description: Prioritised actionable recommendations with article citations. MUST end with disclaimer: This assessment provides structured compliance workflow support and does not constitute legal advice.

overall_status.description: One of: compliant, partially_compliant, non_compliant, scope_not_applicable

provider_status_summary.description: One-sentence statement of GPAI provider status

applicable_obligations_summary.description: Brief summary of which obligation tiers apply

key_findings.description: Top 3-5 key compliance findings for executive audience

enforcement_timeline_summary.description: Relevant enforcement dates and immediate action windows

compliance_memo.description: Professional legal-style compliance memo with assumptions and recommendations

executive_summary.description: Concise executive summary for non-specialist stakeholders

notes: Step 1: Structured intake extraction (elem_003, two-step EXTRACT pattern). KB11: all Optional fields have extraction instructions.

description.template:
GPAI Code of Practice compliance expert. Apply the three-step EU AI Act compliance decision tree:

Step 1 — GPAI Provider (Art. 3(63)): Does the entity develop or have developed a GPAI model and place it on the EU market under its own name/trademark? Or significantly fine-tune one (>=1/3 of original compute or >=1/3 of 10^23 FLOPs)? Is the model on the EU market or put into service in EU?

Step 2 — Open-Source Exemption (Art. 53(2)): Is the model released under a free open-source licence with publicly available weights, architecture, and usage info? If yes AND no systemic risk: set open_source_exemption_applies=true. Copyright obligations still apply. If systemic risk exists, exemption is overridden.

Step 3 — Systemic Risk (Art. 51): Training compute >10^25 FLOPs (Art. 51(2)) OR Commission designation → systemic risk. Approximately 5-15 companies worldwide meet this threshold currently.

Set applicable_tier to: tier1_only (GPAI provider, no systemic risk), tier1_and_tier2 (GPAI provider, systemic risk), or not_applicable (not a GPAI provider).

Extracted intake data:
{call_intake.model_dump_json()}

Original intake text:
{intake_text}

notes: Step 2: Three-step classification — GPAI provider scope, open-source exemption, systemic risk. (dep_002, dep_003, dep_004)

description.template:
GPAI Code of Practice compliance expert. Assess Tier 1 transparency obligations using the reference documentation.

IMPORTANT: If applicable_tier is not_applicable, return all statuses as not_applicable with empty findings and recommendations.

If open_source_exemption_applies=true: Measures 1.1 (technical documentation) and 1.2 (downstream provider info) are NOT required. Training data summary (Art. 53(1)(d)) and Measure 1.3 (documentation integrity) still apply.

Assess each obligation and classify as compliant, partial, non_compliant, or not_applicable:
- Art. 53(1)(a) Annex XI: Technical documentation / Model Documentation Form (Measure 1.1)
- Art. 53(1)(b) Annex XII: Downstream provider info within 14 days of request (Measure 1.2)
- Art. 53(1)(a)-(b): Documentation integrity — accurate, tamper-proof, 10 years (Measure 1.3)
- Art. 53(1)(d): Training data summary — public, uses Commission template

Cite specific article numbers and measure IDs in all findings.

Provider classification:
{call_classify.model_dump_json()}

Transparency obligations reference:
{_load_transparency()}

notes: Step 3: Tier 1 transparency chapter assessment (dep_005). Reference loaded via _load_transparency() helper.

description.template:
GPAI Code of Practice compliance expert. Assess Tier 1 copyright obligations using the reference documentation.

IMPORTANT: Copyright obligations apply to ALL GPAI providers including those with the Art. 53(2) open-source exemption. If applicable_tier is not_applicable, return all as not_applicable.

Assess each of the 7 copyright measures:
- Measure 1.1: Copyright policy — draw up, publish summary, designate accountability
- Measure 1.2: Lawful access only — no paywall circumvention, exclude piracy
- Measure 1.3: Rights reservations — comply with robots.txt and machine-readable opt-outs
- Measure 1.4: Record-keeping — maintain crawling and rights compliance records
- Measure 1.5: Output safeguards — technical measures minimising infringing outputs
- Measure 1.6: Terms of service — prohibit unauthorised copyright use by users
- Measure 1.7: Complaints handling — designated contact, fair complaint process

Classify each as compliant, partial, non_compliant, or not_applicable. Cite Measure numbers.

Provider classification:
{call_classify.model_dump_json()}

Copyright obligations reference:
{_load_copyright_rules()}

notes: Step 4: Tier 1 copyright chapter assessment (dep_006). Reference loaded via _load_copyright_rules() helper.

description.template:
GPAI Code of Practice compliance expert. Assess Tier 2 systemic risk obligations (Art. 55) using the reference documentation.

If has_systemic_risk=false OR applicable_tier is not_applicable: set not_applicable=true and leave all status fields null.

If systemic risk applies, assess each of the 10 Safety & Security Commitments:
- Commitment 1: Safety & Security Framework — create, implement, update, notify AI Office
- Commitment 2: Systemic risk identification — structured process and risk scenarios
- Commitment 3: Systemic risk analysis — evaluations, modelling, adversarial red-teaming
- Commitment 4: Risk acceptance determination — criteria, proceed/stop decision
- Commitment 5: Safety mitigations — lifecycle safety measures
- Commitment 6: Security mitigations — cybersecurity for model and infrastructure
- Commitment 7: Model Reports — pre-market report to AI Office, keep updated
- Commitment 8: Responsibility allocation — clear roles, resources, risk culture
- Commitment 9: Serious incident reporting — track, document, report within deadlines
- Commitment 10: Additional documentation — record-keeping 10 years, public transparency

Classify each as compliant, partial, non_compliant, or not_applicable.

Provider classification:
{call_classify.model_dump_json()}

Systemic risk framework reference:
{_load_systemic_risk_rules()}

notes: Step 5: Tier 2 systemic risk chapter assessment — conditional on has_systemic_risk (dep_007). not_applicable=true when no systemic risk.

description.template:
GPAI Code of Practice compliance expert. Assess DACH-specific overlay requirements.

If is_dach_relevant=false: set not_applicable=true and leave all status fields null.

If DACH presence applies, check:
- BNetzA: designated market surveillance authority for GPAI in Germany under the AI Act
- BSI: cybersecurity guidance alignment for systemic risk models
- BetrVG 87(1) No. 6: works council consultation for internal GPAI deployment in Germany
- Austrian scope: Austrian Data Protection Authority implementation specifics
- Swiss scope: no EU AI Act obligation; Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection and voluntary alignment

Classify each item as: acknowledged, not_addressed, or not_applicable.

Provider classification:
{call_classify.model_dump_json()}

DACH-specific reference:
{_load_dach_rules()}

notes: Step 6: DACH-specific overlay assessment (dep_008). not_applicable=true when is_dach_relevant=false.

description.template:
GPAI Code of Practice compliance expert. Synthesise a complete ComplianceReport from the preceding assessments.

Produce all three components:

1. gap_assessment (ComplianceGapAssessment):
- Set provider_entity, model_name, is_gpai_provider, exemption_level (one of: none/open_source_partial/not_applicable), has_systemic_risk
- transparency_findings: convert TransparencyAssessment findings into ComplianceFinding objects with measure_id, chapter=Transparency, requirement_description, current_status, gap_description, priority, remediation_action, target_date
- copyright_findings: convert CopyrightAssessment findings into ComplianceFinding objects with chapter=Copyright
- safety_security_findings: convert SystemicRiskAssessment findings if applicable (null if not_applicable)
- dach_findings: convert DachAssessment findings if applicable (null if not_applicable)

2. compliance_memo (ComplianceMemo):
- Summarise provider determination, exemption analysis, systemic risk classification, applicable obligations
- List all assumptions explicitly
- MUST end recommendations list with: This assessment provides structured compliance workflow support and does not constitute legal advice. Consult qualified legal counsel.
- Cite AI Act articles throughout (Art. 3(63), Art. 51, Art. 53, Art. 55)

3. executive_summary (ExecutiveSummary):
- Set overall_status: compliant/partially_compliant/non_compliant/scope_not_applicable
- Include enforcement_timeline_summary using the compliance timeline reference dates
- top_3_recommended_actions must be ordered by regulatory urgency
- risk_exposure_summary must reference Art. 99 EU AI Act maximum fines

Provider classification:
{call_classify.model_dump_json()}

Transparency assessment:
{call_transparency.model_dump_json()}

Copyright assessment:
{call_copyright.model_dump_json()}

Systemic risk assessment:
{call_systemic_risk.model_dump_json()}

DACH assessment:
{call_dach.model_dump_json()}

Compliance timeline reference:
{_load_compliance_timeline()}

Output format templates:
{_load_templates_doc()}

description.value: Compliance report must contain all three components: gap_assessment, compliance_memo, and executive_summary with non-empty content
Each compliance finding must have measure_id, chapter, requirement_description, and current_status
